Big East regular season co-champions |tourney= |tourney_result= }} {{2019–20 Big East men's basketball standings}} The '''2019–20 Villanova Wildcats men's basketball team''' represented [[Villanova University]] in the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. Led by head coach [[Jay Wright (basketball)|Jay Wright]] in his 19th year, the Wildcats played their home games at the [[Finneran Pavilion]] on the school's campus in the [[Philadelphia]] suburb of [[Villanova, Pennsylvania]] and [[Wells Fargo Center (Philadelphia)|Wells Fargo Center]] as members of the [[Big East Conference]]. They finished the season 24–7, 13–5 in [[2019–20 Big East Conference men's basketball season|Big East play]] which put them in a three-way tie for first place. As the No. 2 seed in the [[2020 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]], they were slated to play [[2019–20 DePaul Blue Demons men's basketball team|DePaul]] in the quarterfinals, but the Tournament was cancelled due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic]], along with the rest of the [[2020 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA postseason]]. The team officially finished ninth in the Coaches Poll and tenth in the AP Poll, which served as ''de facto'' selectors during the season. ==Previous season== The [[2018–19 Villanova Wildcats men's basketball team|Wildcats]] finished the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2018–19 season]] 26–10, 13–5 in [[2018-19 Big East Conference men's basketball season|Big East play]] to finish in first place. They defeated [[2018–19 Providence Friars men's basketball team|Providence]], [[2018–19 Xavier Musketeers men's basketball team|Xavier]], and [[2018–19 Seton Hall Pirates men's basketball team|Seton Hall]] to win the [[2019 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]].{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/game?gameId=401120748|title=Seton Hall vs. Villanova -
